description: Opens one piece of the plan's work whole: the row with its brief, reason, day, state and forecast; its history, newest kept when it is long; its outcome over the last 90 days (totals by metric, behind, on or ahead of its forecast, and the sources); every observation attributed to it; and, when it waited on a card, what making that card's work cost in tokens (the ledger's own count, or a note that none was recorded). Use it after work_list, or for a work id another tool gave; for many rows' results at once use outcomes_summary. An id that is not on the ledger is refused.

id.description: The work row's id, as work_list, outcomes_summary or crm_timeline give it.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
